method: Read all 2,611 CSV record lines through Files source ranges, count record_type prefixes directly; video extension count restricted to historical filesystem_file paths.

scopeDifference.candidateExplanation: The consolidated C04 manifest states that the standalone generated source manifest CSV is also stored inside Part 1; packaging a generated CSV in Part 1 would produce one extra non-video outer entry absent from original filesystem_file rows.
scopeDifference.sourceForHypothesis: C04 introduction to CSV manifest states that the CSV is also stored inside first complete-source ZIP
scopeDifference.requiredProof: Reopen exact PART1 and PART2 original ZIP bytes; extract all outer entry names and SHA256; compare normalized exact paths with historical filesystem_file excluding the 15 video paths, preserve raw path spelling and duplicates; identify the extra entry and hash.

limitations: Counts establish the historical embedded manifest's internal row tally, not a second current ZIP member count.
Historical ZIP CRC and SHA pass was previously reported but not rerun now.
Every original video was intentionally excluded from image/video frame analysis; the audio transcripts are not video-frame evidence.
Record-type count does not imply that all 2,611 source file contents were semantically inspected.
